notes: Dispatched as a detached systemd-run transient unit on ser8 (D-13); survives SSH disconnect. `backup/media-staging@verified` snapshot created immediately before dispatch (0B used at creation, confirming zero staging writes since Plan 13-04's Gate 3.3 PASS). Task 0 (this plan's mandatory first scope, PR #2 merged to main as 8809c33) had already declaratively disabled all 19 freeze-set units and activated that generation as ser8's boot default before this restore was launched, so an unplanned reboot during the multi-hour transfer will not start any service against a partially-restored mount. Two Rule 1 bugs found and fixed against the plan's literal Step 5.1 command (`.planning/SER8-ZFS-MIRROR-MIGRATION.md` line 772, carried into 13-06-PLAN.md's Task 1 <action>) before the stream ran successfully: (1) `zfs send -s` is `--skip-missing` on this host's zfs-2.4.3-1 and only valid in conjunction with `-R` (replicate) -- it is NOT a resumability-enabling flag; the first dispatch attempt (invocation 915d98c1) failed immediately (exit 1, 'skip-missing flag can only be used in conjunction with replicate') with zero bytes written to media/data (confirmed 96K used, unchanged). Fixed by dropping `-s` entirely -- resumable receive is automatic behavior of `zfs receive` on an interrupted stream (via the destination's `receive_resume_token` property), not something a send-side flag requests; the doc's D-08 rationale ('send -s resume tokens') was a naming-only misunderstanding, not a real requirement gap. (2) The second dispatch (invocation 51cae55b) then failed immediately (exit 1, 'cannot receive new filesystem stream: destination media/data exists -- must specify -F to overwrite it') because `media/data` already exists as an empty dataset with Plan 13-05's declared properties (mountpoint, compression, recordsize, etc.) -- a full (non-incremental) `zfs recv` refuses to receive into an existing destination without `-F`. Confirmed safe to add: `-F` forces a rollback to the most recent snapshot before receiving, and since `media/data` had zero snapshots and zero data, this is a no-op rollback followed by a normal receive; because the send stream does not include `-p`/--props, the destination's pre-set properties from 13-05 are not touched by the receive. The corrected command (invocation 1ba36b7b, `zfs send backup/media-staging@verified | zfs recv -F -u media/data`) reached ActiveState=active/running within seconds and was confirmed transferring real data by re-reading `zfs list media/data` twice 20s apart (3.07G -> 7.18G used, ~205 MB/s, consistent with the phase's measured mirror-write throughput and the doc's timing model). `zpool status media` remained ONLINE with zero read/write/cksum errors on both mirror members throughout. This job's terminal status will be 'completed-unverified' per the established external-job status enum once it exits (no separate 'verified' state) -- Task 2 of this plan (Confirm restore integrity and mount) is the actual verification/closure step, checking ExecMainStatus=0, journal content, and the mount/mountpoint properties before that task's own commit and this plan's eventual SUMMARY.md.
